name: Good Deer 47
author: ilyas-hadi
description: Dark orange button that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, text color changes from #fff to #fff, box-shadow becomes #f51a1a7f 0 30px 60px -12px inset, #ff00007f 0 18px 36px -18px inset, z-index becomes 2.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Good Deer 47</title>
<style>
/* Good Deer 47 by ilyas-hadi — https://uiverse.io/ilyas-hadi/good-deer-47 */
.button {
  padding: 1.1rem 2.2rem;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: all .2s;
  position: relative;
  border: none;
  background: #000;
}

.button:before,.button:after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  background: #ff3d00;
  height: 108%;
  width: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  transition: all .7s;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

.button:before {
  left: 0%;
}

.button:after {
  right: 0%;
}

.button:hover {
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: #f51a1a7f 0 30px 60px -12px inset, #ff00007f 0 18px 36px -18px inset;
  z-index: 2;
}

.button:hover::before {
  width: 50%;
  left: 50%;
}

.button:hover::after {
  width: 50%;
  right: 50%;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
